headline: Türkiye services producer prices rise 0.17% in September, up 33.2% year-on-year
summary: TÜİK reported Türkiye's services producer price index rose 0.17% month-on-month in September, bringing annual services producer price inflation to 33.23%.
why: Services inflation inertia is a primary obstacle to restoring single-digit consumer inflation in emerging economies like Türkiye.

impacts.name: Türkiye
impacts.why: Slowing monthly price growth aids disinflation, though annual rates remain elevated.
